Pilot · China

Liu Chuanjian

Sichuan Airlines Flight 86332018
Flight
Sichuan Airlines Flight 8633
Date
14 May 2018
Aircraft
Airbus A319
Location
Chengdu
Survivors
128 of 128 aboard

The cockpit windshield blew out at cruising altitude. He flew the Airbus A319 manually in freezing, deafening conditions to a safe landing in Chengdu, and no one aboard was killed.

Who helped

  • Liang Peng Second captainCame into the cockpit, reminded the captain to put on his oxygen mask, read out the decompression procedure, and helped with navigation and air traffic control.Sources: 1 2 3
  • Xu Ruichen First officerPartly pulled out through the broken window and injured, he still set the 7700 emergency code on the transponder and kept it active.Sources: 1 2 3
  • Bi Nan Chief purserStayed calm, told passengers over the PA to follow the crew's instructions, and directed the flight attendants to reassure passengers during the descent.Sources: 1 2 3 4

Source: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sichuan_Airlines_Flight_8633 ↗
